formula_or_test: SPFM = 1 - (sum(lambda_SPF + lambda_RF) / sum(lambda_SR)) = sum(lambda_SR_safe + lambda_MPF_lat + lambda_MPF_det) / sum(lambda_SR)
inputs: lambda_SR_safe (safe fault rate of safety-related elements)
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

formula_or_test: LFM = 1 - (sum(lambda_MPF_lat) / (sum(lambda_SR) - sum(lambda_SPF) - sum(lambda_RF))) = sum(lambda_MPF_det + lambda_SR_safe) / (sum(lambda_SR) - sum(lambda_SPF) - sum(lambda_RF))
inputs: lambda_SR_safe (safe fault rate of safety-related elements)
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

calculation: ISO 26262 Hardware Architectural Metrics Target Thresholds by ASIL
formula_or_test: ASIL B: SPFM >= 90%, LFM >= 60%, PMHF < 10^-7 h^-1; ASIL C: SPFM >= 97%, LFM >= 80%, PMHF < 10^-7 h^-1; ASIL D: SPFM >= 99%, LFM >= 90%, PMHF < 10^-8 h^-1
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
JEDEC JESD91A (Critical Failure Method - Temperature Acceleration Factor)

inputs: Failures (number of failed units or chi-square statistically adjusted failure count)
t (test duration in hours per unit)
authority: JEDEC JESD85 (Methods for Calculating Failure Rates in Units of FITs)

formula_or_test: AF_VT = exp((E_a / k) * ((1 / T_use) - (1 / T_stress)) + gamma * (V_stress - V_use))
authority: JEDEC System-Level Reliability and Acceleration Standards (JESD74A)

calculation: Total Processing Performance (TPP) for Export Control Determination
formula_or_test: TPP = 2 * MacTOPS * bit_length (where MacTOPS is the theoretical peak MAC operations per second; test evaluates if TPP >= 4800 or Total Processing Performance density criteria under 3A090.a)
inputs: MacTOPS (Theoretical peak Multiply-Accumulate operations per second)
bit_length (Bit length of the operation, e.g., 8 for INT8, 16 for FP16)
authority: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) 15 CFR Part 774, Supplement No. 1, Category 3

calculation: Performance Density Threshold for Advanced Integrated Circuits Control
formula_or_test: Performance Density = TPP / die_area_mm2 (test evaluates if TPP >= 1600 and Performance Density >= threshold specified in ECCN 3A090.a)
inputs: die_area_mm2 (Total die area in square millimeters including logic and memory components integrated in single package)
authority: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) 15 CFR Part 774, Supplement No. 1, Category 3

calculation: Advanced Manufacturing Investment Credit (CHIPS Act Section 48D Tax Credit Rate)
inputs: Qualified_Investment_Basis (Basis of qualified property placed in service for advanced semiconductor manufacturing facilities)
authority: Internal Revenue Code (26 U.S.C.) Section 48D as enacted by CHIPS Act of 2022

calculation: CHIPS Act Expansion Transaction Threshold (Guardrail Clause)
formula_or_test: Significant Expansion Test = (Added_Production_Capacity >= 0.05 * Pre_Existing_Capacity) in a Foreign Country of Concern
inputs: Added_Production_Capacity (Production volume/wafer capacity added via transaction)
authority: 15 CFR Part 231 - Preventing the Unlawful Use of CHIPS Act Funding (DOC/BIS Final Rule)

calculation: CHIPS Act Legacy Technology Node Thresholds for Logic Chips
formula_or_test: Legacy Logic Threshold Test = Non-planar transistor architecture (e.g., planar MOSFET) AND gate length >= 28 nm
inputs: Production Node Feature Size / Gate Length (nm)
authority: 15 CFR Part 231 - Preventing the Unlawful Use of CHIPS Act Funding

calculation: CoFDM / Black-Box Blackout Mean Time To Failure (MTTF) under Exponential Failure Distribution
inputs: lambda_i (individual component failure rate per hour)
FIT_i (Failures In Time for individual chip components)
authority: MIL-HDBK-217F Reliability Prediction of Electronic Equipment
